Projects whose toolchain has no plugin API (Angular CLI, plain webpack, custom servers) get an HTML `page` artifact. My memory records this as one of the owner's earlier decisions, alongside "Option C live components", "pins applied by the agent" and "real code from the first screen". All of them still stand.

The Vite route is the `cawcoStage()` plugin serving `/@cawco/sheet`, which is slice 1 of live components.

My memory doesn't hold the discussion that settled the page-artifact decision, such as the exact wording, the date, or the alternatives weighed. It only keeps the outcome. The earlier summary may have those details.
